doctrine: Fail closed. Signed is not correct. Live is not qualified. Blocked tests stay failed.

clusters.title: Quarantine ReceiptAgent v3
clusters.order: Remove from every flagship collection. Rebuild the card from the exact training receipt. No promotion until bytes and a v2-versus-v3 bakeoff exist.
clusters.done_when: Card is no longer a template; adapter bytes exist or the ID is explicitly non-release; collection membership is research-only.

clusters.title: Repair or relabel Khipu-abstain
clusters.order: Empty adapter must not look like a product. Recover weights or demote to an experiment ledger with a hard redirect.
clusters.done_when: Either usable adapter bytes are published with a receipt, or the Hub card is labelled experiment/empty and removed from flagship.

clusters.title: Fix published kernel CI
clusters.order: Published torch.compile / test failures stay failed. Fix or publish an explicit unsupported matrix. No acceleration story until green.
clusters.done_when: CI is green on the declared matrix, or the card states BLOCKED with the failing tests linked.

clusters.title: Remove unsafe serialization
clusters.order: Pickle/joblib/unsafe persistence is a publication block. Convert to safetensors, skops, or transparent coefficients. Delete opaque executables from Hub.
clusters.done_when: No public kernel or companion ships pickle/joblib; cards state the safe format.

clusters.title: Quarantine failed Chaski line
clusters.order: chaski failed qualification. 5050 leaks owner-machine paths. A11OY-MINI is a derived GGUF of a failed parent. Remove from flagship. Keep only as negative evidence.
clusters.done_when: None of the three appear in a promoted collection; 5050 metadata no longer contains absolute local paths.

clusters.title: Unblock szl-blocked and szl-provctl surfaces
clusters.order: Admission kernel and provenance controller cannot carry a blocked public state while being sold as the pre-action core. Fix tests and unsafe files, or label SOFTWARE_LIMITED with no product claim.
clusters.done_when: Blocked tokens are gone from public maturity, or the card is explicitly non-release.

lanes.title: ReceiptAgent tournament
lanes.order: One hidden Governed Model Bench. Quarantine v3. Compare nano, v2, 1.5B, and base. Select one winner at a declared false-ALLOW budget. Merge and quantize only after full-precision qualification.
lanes.done_when: A single promoted ReceiptAgent ID exists with sample-level logs, controller-bound vs naked decode, and a published risk point.

lanes.title: Khipu abstention bench
lanes.order: Expand beyond 2/6 and 3/6 research scores. Hidden handle set. Coverage-risk curve. Invented-identifier rate. Controller-only baseline. Do not promote R3 merely because training finished.
lanes.done_when: One Khipu operating point is frozen in the controller contract; derivatives carry their own post-quant eval.

lanes.title: Chaski stays research-only
lanes.order: No flagship placement. One family leaderboard: base / R2 / 5050 / archived parent. Promote only after a held-out JSON/refusal gate beats the disclosed baseline.
lanes.done_when: Chaski collection is research-only; A11OY-MINI is unpinned or rebuilt from a winning parent.
